## What landed (two commits — stage boundaries preserved)

### Stage 1 — FP runner rules (`8cc975b8`)

`crates/hh-runner/src/continuation.rs` (~1.7k lines):

- **`hh-fp-continuation-input/1`** strict decode. The firewall is a
  refusal, not a filter: `check_cost_only` walks every nesting level
  and refuses any member of the REQ-XH-121 sealed set (verdict,
  reward, ctrf, executed{…}, verifier output, …) as
  `refused{outcome_field}`; `inconclusive{infra:*}` dispositions pass
  (the carve-out holds may read).
- **The one projection formula** (REQ-XH-112): `p̂_h = 1.2 ×
  max(1.5 × mean_h, P90_h)` over ≥ 10 measured trials else the
  §10.1.5 binding prior — integer µ$, ceiling per line (R6.7). The
  step-fit test `Σ_h remaining_h × p̂_h ≤ root − consumed − Σ orphans
  at bounded.hi − C × s`.
- **The automatic checkpoint** (`run_checkpoint`): re-project at each
  round boundary, withhold the remaining slots of the lowest-priority
  arms in the declared drop order (the `ArmPriority` parameter —
  Q-X61's recorded default V5 → Claude Code → Pi is a fixture
  constant, never hard-coded); a protected-pair breach withholds
  every remaining slot and P2-FP/P3-L2/P4-FP refuse primary inference
  `protected_pair_truncated{k<5,R<5}`. The `hh-fp-checkpoint/1`
  readout carries cost fields only plus the REQ-XC-322 `queue_wait +
  latency` p99 report against each admitted client timeout. Every
  drop labelled verbatim "cost-triggered; cost correlates with
  failure length".
- **Per-arm µ$ caps** (REQ-XH-117): `cap_h = planned_slots_h × p̂_h`,
  `hh-fp-arm-caps/1` formula table; expected-cost admission
  `consumed_h + Σ in-flight max(p̂, consumed-to-date) + p̂ ≤ cap_h`,
  else the arm's remaining slots `withheld{budget}` — no cell, never
  a scored refusal; the slice is reserved against the root only
  (overshoot bounded by in-flight × (s − p̂)); protected arms bounded
  by root + checkpoint only; `first_pass_family` retains a dropped
  arm's member as unavailable.
- **Spend enforcement / censored bound** (REQ-XD-040 + REQ-XC-211):
  a capped arm's cost reports `basis: censored_lower_bound`.
- **Wall time** (REQ-XH-126): `t̂_h = 1.1 × mean` (≥ 3 trials) else
  the 1,040 s prior, the native-lane arms on original mini's t̂;
  `W_p` with the ⌈0.1×⌉ retry allowance and carried-load terms;
  `d_max_ms` over R6.14's ceilings (billed where reconciled else
  ceiling; an unauthorized Wc contributes only the restart-overflow
  reservation `r×1h + S·r_disk·h_r`); drops in the same order at FP-E
  and round boundaries; `withhold_pair_deadline` +
  `check_pair_closure` make the O/H pair atomic — never one slot.
- **§6.6 stop rules** (REQ-XD-042): budget (the root cap), infra
  (PP0 ≥ 1/3 holds the arm `withheld{admission:pp0_infra_hold}`; the
  window stage >20 % after ≥ 10 stops it `withheld{infra}`; ≥ 3
  stopped arms stops the pass), integrity (six events, everything
  stops at once, partial rows kept), calendar (credit period end,
  unless the recorded operator override). A fifth kind — any
  outcome-shaped trigger — refuses `unsupported{stop_trigger}`.

### Stage 2 — FP holds (`e5ccefca` + hygiene `8508b372`)

`crates/hh-runner/src/holds.rs` (~850 lines):

- **Fallback (REQ-XH-123):** `Gl1Status` (both gate partitions +
  pass id) and the `TriggerRecord` (`fps_otherwise_ready_ms` +
  `trigger_after_days`, the Q-X62 record — days read from the
  record, never hard-coded). `fallback_decision` → hosted-only on a
  both-partition failure or a fired trigger; `hh-fp-fallback/1`
  carries the hosted-only arm set, both `withheld{l1_not_passed}`
  dispositions (P3-L2, P4-FP) and the cited `trigger_ref`.
- **Lane probe (REQ-XH-124):** `lane_probe_plan` — one receipted
  call per pinned effort path on the declared surface's route;
  `lane_probe_bound` — the ≤ $0.05 plan bound through the one
  pricing implementation (CC1); `run_lane_probe` → `hh-lane-probe/1`
  over R6.26's `ProbeTransport` seam, recorded before the first
  HH-native slot. `native_lane_hold`: a failed probe or ≥ 1
  infra-failed slot among the arm's first 3 →
  `withheld{admission:native_lane_hold}` while hosted arms continue;
  `repair: new_h_version_requires_new_g_l1` (REQ-XD-102). The
  `w4-lane-probe` leg is registered in `scripts/live-verify.sh`
  (executes in W4 under FP-E by R6.47 — `skipped(...)` until then);
  `test-live-verify.sh` covers registration/budget/NAME legs.
- **PP0 holds (REQ-XH-127):** `Pp0TrialEvidence` — infra member +
  AG3/AG5/AG6/AG8 only; a task verdict refuses typed. Dispositions:
  (a) held Pi/Claude Code → `withheld{admission:AG<n>}` naming the
  smallest failed gate or `withheld{admission:pp0_infra_hold}` for an
  infra-only hold; drops from `fp_e_arms`, retained unavailable in
  its family; (b) held original mini-swe-agent →
  `hh-fp-scope-decision/1`, default `end_pass_after_w2`, corpus
  withheld, G-L1 `cannot_pass`, all four claims withheld by the
  hold's typed reason, repair a later pass; (c)
  `replace_empty_cell` — easy|hard → medium committed order with
  `disclosure: true` (an emptied medium cell has no declared donor:
  typed refusal, recorded reading).
